name: field
title: Field
description: Form field layout with a label, required indicator, help text, and error message.
notes: Pass one form control as the child. The field connects its label, help text, required state, and error message to that control. Pass a reactive `error` from your form validation; the field does not validate the value itself. Clear the error when the value is valid.

reference.scope: Source reference; dashboard behavior cannot be verified on the public marketing site.
